title: Channel page, Sales tab: storefront not set up
summary: DJDL's Steam channel page opened from a Not set up row on Storefronts: Not set up beside the title, and the Sales tab's storefront wizard with only the human steps (create the app in Steamworks, add the publisher key in Connections, assign the app to DJDL), each ticking itself when Polaris Key sees it, beside a rail card saying what Steam can and can't sell.
compare: It is the same channel page as commerce.sales (A-22): the xl Steam tile, the h1 with 'Not set up', tabs Status, Releases, Listing, Sales, Setup; a Not set up row on Storefronts lands here. Crumbs say Storefronts › Steam and the Commerce sidebar entry stays active.
Sales shows the wizard because the storefront side isn't set up; Releases renders on its own (O12); its tab is the way there.

Only human steps appear (A-18k): each is one thing to do outside Polaris Key, in Steam's own words, with one deep link, and ticks itself when Polaris Key sees it done. Nothing asks for an App ID: step 3 picks the app in Store connections and the id is read from Steam.

The step count matches Storefronts and first-run ('3 steps'), and the card head carries the '0 of 3 done' meter. The first step's action is the page's one primary; a step that depends on others waits (the clock mark) and says what it needs instead of offering a button that can't work.
The foot says when Polaris Key last checked and how often ('Checked 10:38 · every 10 minutes'), with Check now; a polite live region announces each tick.
What Steam can sell is stated once, in plain words: the paid app and DLC, then 'No subscriptions' and 'No price API: set prices in Steamworks' on their own lines.
Wide: the rail is 400px beside the steps. Tablet and phone: the rail card drops under the steps; on phone each step's action goes under its text.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
Step 2 reads 'Add a publisher key in Connections' with 'Open Connections' (deep link to the Stores group); no 'Store connections' anywhere (admin-3-16).
B17: the Status, Releases, Listing and Setup tabs carry release; the publisher-key step is core (Connections); the rest is commerce.

findings.issue: Verbose, mechanism-led copy; inconsistent step icons; ungrammatical Releases line.
findings.resolution: Card subtitle cut; steps 'Create DJDL's app in Steamworks' (Needs the Steam Direct fee.), 'Add a publisher key', 'Pick DJDL's app' (Waiting for steps 1 and 2); one icon for steps not started; rail is three bullets; 'Builds are set up on Releases.'; Check now sits on the task text edge.
